scientific_integrity: Proof supplies the finite-horizon invariant-subspace recursion, a strict all-horizon extremizer comparison, Perron eigenvalue characterization, and limiting aspect-ratio analysis; a standalone exact-rational checker independently compares full-matrix covariance. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Uniform i.i.d. edge sampling and exact two-endpoint arithmetic averaging on complete bipartite graphs with both parts of size at least two; expected squared error only. The result does not address quenched rates, pathwise bounds, noisy data or heterogeneous sampling. A general tensor-power MSE formula is prior art and is not claimed as new.
title: Sharp finite-horizon disagreement modes and a continuous aspect-ratio speedup law for bipartite gossip
